title: Run new task
description: Open an app, folder or document. Startup arguments are supported.
administratorHint: Requires Windows authorization. Canceling it leaves the task unstarted.
standardHint: When unchecked, the task runs with standard permissions.
waiting: Waiting for Windows to finish starting the task or request authorization.

error.invalid: Enter a valid app name, path or command, up to 8192 characters.
error.cancelled: Windows authorization was canceled. The task was not started.
error.notFound: The app or path could not be found. Check the input or choose Browse.
error.accessDenied: Windows denied the launch. Check the access permissions.
error.standardUnavailable: The standard-permission launch environment could not be prepared.
error.elevationRequired: This app requires administrator permissions. Select Run as administrator and retry.
error.noAssociation: No application is associated with this item.
error.busy: Another launch request is still in progress. Try again shortly.
error.os: Windows could not start this task.
